name: com.playfab.unitysdk
description: Placeholder stub for PlayFab SDK. Replace with the real SDK via one of: (A) Import PlayFabAllSDK.unitypackage from https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/gaming/playfab/sdks/unity/quickstart, (B) Add git URL https://github.com/PlayFab/UnitySDK.git#upm via Package Manager, or (C) Delete this folder and extract the real SDK to Packages/com.playfab.unitysdk/. Then add USE_PLAYFAB to Player Settings scripting defines.
